name: langpro_annotator
description: An annotation tool for LangPro, a tableau-based theorem prover for natural logic and language.
author: Research Software Lab, Centre for Digital Humanities, Utrecht University

scripts.install-func: yarn func -- pip install -r requirements.txt && playwright install
scripts.postinstall: yarn fyarn && yarn install-back && yarn install-func
scripts.test: yarn test-back && yarn test-front && yarn test-func
scripts.start-back: cd backend && python manage.py runserver --settings glue --pythonpath ..
scripts.livereload-back: cd backend && python manage.py livereload --settings glue --pythonpath ..
scripts.start: yarn start-front & yarn start-back & yarn watch-back
scripts.collectstatic-p: cd backend && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput -v 0 --settings collect --pythonpath ..
scripts.static-p: yarn build && yarn clean-static && yarn collectstatic-p
scripts.start-back-p: cd backend && python manage.py runserver --settings settings --pythonpath ../private
scripts.start-back-p-local: cd backend && python manage.py runserver --settings production --insecure --pythonpath ..
scripts.start-front-func-test: cd frontend && ng serve --port 4200 & while ! nc -z localhost 4200; do sleep 1; done
scripts.start-p: yarn start-back-p & sleep 5 && yarn static-p && yarn watch-front-p
scripts.stop-back: lsof -t -i tcp:8000 | xargs kill -9 || echo "not running"
